details.description:
The Science of the Sip: Your Weight Loss Partner
When it comes to your fitness and weight loss journey, what you drink is just as important as what you eat. Lipton Green Tea is designed to be the ideal companion for those looking to embrace a lighter, more active lifestyle. Unlike traditional chai, which is often prepared with milk and sugar, green tea offers a zero-calorie alternative that helps you stay on track with your goals without compromising on flavour.
The secret to its effectiveness lies in the careful way it is produced. As soon as the fresh tea leaves are plucked, they are heated, cut, and dried. This process prevents oxidation, ensuring that the leaves retain most of the catechins. These natural antioxidants are known to support metabolism and aid fat oxidation. By incorporating green tea into your daily routine, you can help your body burn energy more efficiently, making your weight management efforts more effective.
A Flavour for Every Mood
Choosing health should never feel like a chore or a compromise. To keep your wellness journey enjoyable, Lipton offers a vibrant range of naturally flavoured options, free from artificial additives, flavours, and colours—just the pure goodness of nature in every cup.
Whether you are looking for a morning boost or a mid-afternoon refreshment, there is a flavour perfectly suited to your mood. Honey Lemon offers a balanced blend of zesty citrus and gentle sweetness, making it a popular everyday choice. Clear & Light is ideal for those who prefer a clean, unflavoured cup with subtle, earthy notes. Raspberry Mint provides a refreshing fruity twist with a cooling finish, while Lemongrass Ginger delivers a warm and invigorating blend to keep you energised throughout the day.

details.description:
It’s not just a
cup of tea - it’s therapy, one sip at a time.
Lipton Green Tea
is not just a regular cup of chai — it’s therapy for your body. Wake up to a
morning cup of hot Lipton Green Tea and feel how it leaves you light and
active. Awaken your senses, one sip at a time. Lipton Green Tea Bags in Honey
Lemon flavour bring you this refreshing goodness. Choose Lipton Green Tea Honey
Lemon as your go-to beverage during the day. Buy now!
Magic of Green Tea
Green tea is made when freshly plucked leaves are heated, rolled or cut, and
then dried. The catechins in the fresh leaves are preserved during the green
tea process, making it naturally rich in antioxidants. Green tea is typically
consumed without milk and sugar, giving it zero calories compared to ordinary
chai made with milk and sugar.
Available in a Range
of Flavours
Lipton offers a range of flavours to bring variety and enjoyment to your tea
moments. Some of Lipton’s teas are flavoured with added natural ingredients —
no artificial flavours are used. Try Lipton Green Tea in Pure & Light
(unflavoured), Tulsi Natura, Honey & Lemon, or Lemon Zest variants,
available in pack sizes of 10 and 25 tea bags.
Next Best to Water
Brewed unsweetened Lipton Green Tea, being 99.5% water, is a great way to help
meet your daily fluid intake. Staying hydrated is essential to ensure that your
body functions efficiently.

details.description:
Lipton Metabolism Boost is designed to support your weight
loss goals with the combined benefits of green tea and apple cider vinegar.
Each tablet contains 150 mg of green tea catechins and 50 mg of apple cider
vinegar, formulated to help burn body fat, reduce waistline, and control
cravings.
Green tea is rich in antioxidants known as catechins, which
help boost metabolism and enhance fat oxidation, making it a strong companion
for a weight loss journey. Each effervescent tablet delivers twice the
catechins compared to a regular green tea bag and may help you lose up to 30
percent more belly fat when combined with an active lifestyle and a balanced
diet.
Lipton Metabolism Boost is both effective and enjoyable,
available in refreshing Green Apple and Watermelon flavours. With zero
calories, it offers a healthier alternative to sugary beverages such as cola or
fruit juices. It is well suited for those who enjoy detox green tea or herbal
teas, or who are looking for a highly rated green tea option for weight loss in
a more flavourful form.
Usage is simple. Drop one tablet into 250 ml of water, allow
it to dissolve, and enjoy a refreshing drink.
Made with natural flavours and colours, Lipton Metabolism
Boost is a convenient and appealing choice to support your weight loss routine.
Supercharge your metabolism with Lipton Metabolism Boost.
